headline: Video: If RI Is Downgraded to Standalone Market, Here's the Effect on IHSG-Rupiah
summary: Commentary on CNBC Indonesia examines the effects on the IHSG index, the rupiah and government bonds if Indonesia is moved to standalone market status by MSCI.
why: MSCI index classifications determine how much global passive and active investment flows into a country's equities, so a reclassification affects foreign demand.
original_headline: Video: Jika RI Turun ke Standalone Market, Ini Efeknya ke IHSG-Rupiah
